rows.description: The original 3D floor plan for Home Assistant: draw your home in the built-in editor and see and control lights, covers, climate, media, sensors and cameras live in neon 3D – panel and dashboard card, runs on old wall tablets too.
Home Assistant integration for Dreame robot vacuums with map support

This card provides a user-friendly way to fully control map-based vacuums in Home Assistant. Supported brands include Xiaomi (Roborock/Viomi/Dreame/Roidmi/Valetudo/Valetudo RE), Neato, Wyze, Roomba, Ecovacs (and probably more).

Bring new life to Home Assistant. By mapping entities to a SVG-object, you're able to control devices, show states, calling services - and much more. Add custom styling on top, to visualize whatever you can think of. Your imagination just became the new limit.
Helios - Make your energy visible, in 2.5D in a Lovelace card for Home Assistant
